The aligned phrases are fed into another feedforward network $G$ : $\mathbf {v}_{i}^{a} = G([\mathbf {w}_{i}^{a}; \mathbf {\beta }_{i}]) $ and $\mathbf {v}_{j}^{b} = G([\mathbf {w}_{j}^{b}; \mathbf {\alpha }_{j}]) $ to generate sets $\lbrace \mathbf {v}_{i}^{a}\rbrace $ and $\lbrace \mathbf {v}_{j}^{b}\rbrace $ , which are aggregated by summation and then concatenated together for classification.
